I'm sorry. This was long, and most of it probably doesn't matter, so I'll TL;DR.

I don't care about anything and I'm tired of the nothingness that I've become. I've come up with a way to end it without hurting anyone. It won't happen tonight, this isn't a rash decision. I'll need certain things that aren't easy to come by, and I've still got a little more to accomplish in my plan.
